title: API Created Transparent Linear Model
subtitle: Auditable coefficients for a deterministic educational regression example
description:
# Model Summary

A transparent linear model created through the Kaggle API for reproducible educational examples.

# Model Characteristics

The model stores an intercept and one slope in human-readable JSON.

# Data Overview

It matches deterministic, synthetic, non-personal regression data.

# Evaluation Results

The coefficients reproduce every target row exactly.
provenanceSources: Generated from the documented deterministic relationship target = 3.5 + 2.25 * x.
